⚖️ Linear & Quadratic Inequalities一次与二次不等式

Linear inequalities & interval notation一次不等式与区间记号

A taxi charges a flag fee plus a price per km, and you have 30 dollars. The answer is not one distance — it is every distance up to a limit. That is an inequality.出租车收起步价加每公里费用，你只有 30 加元。答案不是一个距离，而是某个上限以内的所有距离——这就是不等式。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Linear inequalities & interval notation一次不等式与区间记号
  1. Solve like an equation; multiply or divide by a NEGATIVE → flip the sign.像解方程一样解；乘或除以负数 → 不等号反向。
  2. ≤,≥: closed dot, square bracket. <,>: open dot, round bracket. ∞ always round.≤,≥：实心点、方括号。<,>：空心点、圆括号。∞ 永远用圆括号。
  3. Double inequality: do the same step to all three parts.连写不等式：每一步对三部分同时做。
a<b and k<0 ⇒ ka>kb
x≤4 ⇔ (−∞,4]

🧗 The hard part难点 · Linear inequalities & interval notation一次不等式与区间记号

Brackets, negatives and the flip in one problem括号、负号和变号同时出现

Distributing a minus sign and deciding when to flip both happen at once.要同时处理负号去括号和何时变号。

  1. 3−2(x+4)≥x+7
  2. 3−2x−8≥x+7⇒−2x−5≥x+7
  3. −3x≥12⇒x≤−4 (÷ negative: flip)−3x≥12⇒x≤−4（除以负数，变号）
  4. Test x=−5: 3−2(−1)=5≥2, true验 x=−5：3−2(−1)=5≥2，成立
Try试一试
Solve 5−3(x−1)<2x−7.解 5−3(x−1)<2x−7。
Answer答案
x>3, i.e. (3,∞)x>3，即 (3,∞)

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Linear inequalities & interval notation一次不等式与区间记号
  • −4x≥12⇒x≥−3 → x≤−3.−4x≥12⇒x≥−3 → 应为 x≤−3。
  • x<5 as (−∞,5] → (−∞,5).x<5 写成 (−∞,5] → 应为 (−∞,5)。
🎯
Test one number from your answer in the original; 10 seconds catches a missed flip.从答案里取一个数代回原式，10 秒就能发现忘了变号。

⚖️ Linear & Quadratic Inequalities一次与二次不等式

Quadratic inequalities (sign analysis)二次不等式（符号分析）

For which times is the ball higher than 15 m? For which prices does the business make a profit? Both are "where is the parabola above (or below) a line" — a quadratic inequality.球在哪段时间高于 15 m？票价在什么范围内能盈利？两者都是在问「抛物线什么时候在某条线的上方（或下方）」——这就是二次不等式。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 40 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Quadratic inequalities (sign analysis)二次不等式（符号分析）
  1. Everything to one side, find the zeros, then decide the sign between and outside them.移到一边，求零点，再判断零点之间和两侧的符号。
  2. Opens up: negative BETWEEN the zeros, positive OUTSIDE.开口向上：零点之间为负，两侧为正。
  3. ≤,≥ include the zeros; outside answers are joined by "or" (∪).≤,≥ 包括零点；两侧的答案用「或」(∪) 连接。
a(x−r)(x−s)<0, a>0, r<s ⇒ r<x<s
a(x−r)(x−s)>0, a>0 ⇒ x<r or x>s

🧗 The hard part难点 · Quadratic inequalities (sign analysis)二次不等式（符号分析）

A negative leading coefficient首项系数为负

Multiplying by −1 flips the inequality; forgetting reverses the whole answer.乘以 −1 要变号；忘了就整个答案反过来。

  1. −2x2+5x+3≤0
  2. ×(−1), flip: 2x2−5x−3≥0乘 −1 并变号：2x2−5x−3≥0
  3. (2x+1)(x−3)≥0 → outside the zeros(2x+1)(x−3)≥0 → 取零点两侧
  4. x≤−21​ or x≥3x≤−21​ 或 x≥3
Try试一试
Solve −2x2+5x+3≤0.解 −2x2+5x+3≤0。
Answer答案
x≤−21​ or x≥3x≤−21​ 或 x≥3

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Quadratic inequalities (sign analysis)二次不等式（符号分析）
  • x2>16⇒x>±4 → x<−4 or x>4.x2>16⇒x>±4 → 应为 x<−4 或 x>4。
  • −x2+x+6≥0 read as opening up → opens down: −2≤x≤3.−x2+x+6≥0 当成开口向上 → 实际开口向下：−2≤x≤3。
🎯
Sketch a tiny parabola through the zeros; it is faster than a full sign chart.过零点画个小抛物线草图，比完整符号表快。

⚖️ Linear & Quadratic Inequalities一次与二次不等式

Domain & range limits in context实际问题中的定义域与值域

The formula h(t)=−5t2+20t happily gives you a height at t=−2 or t=10 — but the ball did not exist before it was thrown, and it stops at the ground. Real situations cut the graph down to the part that makes sense.公式 h(t)=−5t2+20t 在 t=−2 或 t=10 时也能算出高度——可球在抛出之前并不存在，落地后也不会钻进地里。实际问题只保留图象中有意义的那一段。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 25 min

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Domain & range limits in context实际问题中的定义域与值域
  1. Domain in context: time from 0 to landing, lengths >0, counts are whole numbers.情境中的定义域：时间从 0 到落地，长度 >0，个数取整数。
  2. Range in context: the vertex value (if inside the domain) and the endpoint values.情境中的值域：顶点值（若在定义域内）和端点值。
  3. "At least / more than" → solve the inequality, then cut it to the domain.「至少／超过」→ 解不等式，再截到定义域内。
h(t)≥0  and  t≥0

🧗 The hard part难点 · Domain & range limits in context实际问题中的定义域与值域

Cutting the inequality answer to the domain把不等式的解截到定义域内

The algebra gives intervals that can include negative times or impossible sizes.代数解出来的区间可能含负时间或不可能的尺寸。

  1. h=−5t2+5t+30; lands: t2−t−6=0⇒t=3h=−5t2+5t+30；落地：t2−t−6=0⇒t=3
  2. Below 20: −5t2+5t+10<0⇒t2−t−2>0低于 20：−5t2+5t+10<0⇒t2−t−2>0
  3. Algebra: t<−1 or t>2代数解：t<−1 或 t>2
  4. Cut to 0≤t≤3: 2<t≤3截到 0≤t≤3：2<t≤3
Try试一试
A rock is thrown from a 30 m cliff: h(t)=−5t2+5t+30. During what times is it below 20 m?从 30 m 高的悬崖抛出一块石头：h(t)=−5t2+5t+30。什么时间段它低于 20 m？
Answer答案
2<t≤3 s (it lands at 3 s; t<−1 is rejected)2<t≤3 秒（3 秒落地；t<−1 舍去）

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Domain & range limits in context实际问题中的定义域与值域
  • Domain of a ball model "all real numbers" → 0≤t≤tland​.小球模型定义域写「全体实数」→ 应为 0≤t≤tland​。
  • Range from the endpoints only → include the vertex (the top of an arch).只用端点求值域 → 还要算顶点（拱形的最高点）。
🎯
Write the domain first; every later answer must sit inside it.先写定义域；后面每个答案都要落在里面。

quiz.q: Solve 2x+7<15 and write the answer in interval notation.解 2x+7<15，用区间记号写出答案。
quiz.a: x<4, (−∞,4)x<4，(−∞,4)
quiz.sol: • 2x<8⇒x<4.2x<8⇒x<4。
quiz.goal: Solve a two-step linear inequality and give the interval.解两步一次不等式并写成区间。
quiz.idea: Subtract 7, then divide by the positive 2: no flip.先减 7，再除以正数 2，不变号。

quiz.q: Which is the interval notation for x≥−2?x≥−2 的区间记号是：
c: (−2,∞)
[−2,∞)
[−2,∞]
(−∞,−2]
quiz.a: [−2,∞)
quiz.sol: • Square bracket at −2, round bracket at ∞.−2 处方括号，∞ 处圆括号。
quiz.goal: Match an inequality to the right brackets in interval notation.把不等式对应到区间记号的正确括号。
quiz.idea: Square bracket if the endpoint is included, round if not; infinity always gets a round bracket.包含端点用方括号，不含用圆括号；无穷大永远用圆括号。

quiz.q: A number line shows an open dot at 1 with shading to the right. Which set matches?数轴上 1 处是空心点，向右涂色。对应哪个集合？
c: {x∣x≥1, x∈R}
{x∣x>1, x∈R}
{x∣x<1, x∈R}
{x∣x≤1, x∈R}
quiz.a: {x∣x>1, x∈R}
quiz.sol: • Open → strict >; shading right → greater than.空心 → 严格 >；向右 → 大于。
quiz.goal: Translate a number line (open dot, shading) into set notation.把数轴（空心点、涂色方向）翻译成集合记号。
quiz.idea: Open dot means strict inequality; shading to the right means greater than.空心点表示严格不等号；向右涂表示大于。

quiz.q: Solve 5−3x≥2x+20.解 5−3x≥2x+20。
quiz.a: x≤−3, (−∞,−3]x≤−3，(−∞,−3]
quiz.sol: • −3x−2x≥20−5⇒−5x≥15⇒x≤−3.−3x−2x≥20−5⇒−5x≥15⇒x≤−3。
quiz.goal: Solve with x on both sides and a negative coefficient.解两边都含 x 且出现负系数的不等式。
quiz.idea: Collect x terms on one side; if the coefficient ends up negative, flip when dividing.把 x 项集中到一边；若系数为负，除的时候变号。

quiz.q: Solve −3<2x+1≤9 and write it in interval notation.解 −3<2x+1≤9，用区间记号表示。
quiz.a: −2<x≤4, (−2,4]−2<x≤4，(−2,4]
quiz.sol: • Subtract 1: −4<2x≤8. Divide by 2: −2<x≤4.减 1：−4<2x≤8；除以 2：−2<x≤4。
quiz.goal: Solve a three-part (compound) inequality and write it as an interval.解三段式不等式并写成区间。
quiz.idea: Whatever you do to the middle, do to the left and right parts too.对中间做什么运算，左右两端就做同样的运算。

quiz.q: A taxi charges 3.50 dollars plus 2.50 dollars per km. You have 30 dollars. Write and solve an inequality for the distance d you can travel.出租车起步价 3.50 加元，每公里 2.50 加元。你有 30 加元。列不等式并求可乘坐的距离 d。
quiz.a: 0≤d≤10.6 km
quiz.sol:
• 2.5d≤26.5⇒d≤10.6.2.5d≤26.5⇒d≤10.6。
  • Distance cannot be negative, so 0≤d≤10.6 km.距离不能为负，所以 0≤d≤10.6 km。
quiz.goal: Turn a fare description into an inequality and give an answer that makes sense for distance.把收费描述变成不等式，并给出符合距离实际的答案。
quiz.idea: Total cost = flag fee + rate × distance, and it must not exceed the budget; then cut off impossible negative distances.总费用 = 起步价 + 单价 × 距离，且不能超过预算；最后截掉不可能的负距离。

quiz.q: Solve 2(x−3)−5x>4−(x+2).解 2(x−3)−5x>4−(x+2)。
quiz.a: x<−4, (−∞,−4)x<−4，(−∞,−4)
quiz.sol: • −3x−6>2−x⇒−2x>8⇒x<−4.−3x−6>2−x⇒−2x>8⇒x<−4。
quiz.goal: Expand brackets on both sides, collect terms and keep track of the flip.两边展开括号、合并同类项，并把变号处理对。
quiz.idea: Expand first, simplify each side, and only then collect x; the flip happens at the end.先展开并化简两边，再集中 x；变号只出现在最后一步。

quiz.q: A ski hill sells a season pass for 480 dollars, but pass holders must also buy their own equipment once for 150 dollars. Without a pass you pay 65 dollars for a day ticket plus 30 dollars to rent equipment each day. Let d be the number of ski days. For which d is the pass cheaper? A skier plans 6 days: which option should she choose? Justify.某滑雪场季卡 480 加元，持卡者还要一次性自购装备 150 加元。不买季卡则每天日票 65 加元，另加每天租装备 30 加元。设滑雪天数为 d。d 取什么值时季卡更便宜？如果她计划滑 6 天，应选哪种？说明理由。
quiz.a: d>6.6, so the pass is cheaper from 7 days on. For 6 days choose day tickets (570 dollars vs 630 dollars).d>6.6，所以滑 7 天及以上季卡更便宜。滑 6 天应选日票（570 加元对 630 加元）。
quiz.sol:
• Pass option: 480+150=630 dollars, no matter how many days.季卡方案：480+150=630 加元，与天数无关。
  • Day tickets: 65d+30d=95d dollars.日票方案：65d+30d=95d 加元。
  • Pass is cheaper when 630<95d, so d>95630​=19126​≈6.6.季卡更便宜当 630<95d，即 d>95630​=19126​≈6.6。
  • Days are whole numbers, so d≥7. For d=6: 95×6=570<630, so day tickets win.天数是整数，所以 d≥7。d=6 时 95×6=570<630，日票更划算。
quiz.goal: Model two cost plans as linear expressions, compare them with an inequality, and interpret the result for whole days.把两种方案建成一次式，用不等式比较，并按整数天数解释结果。
quiz.idea: Cost of each plan as a function of days, then ask when plan A < plan B; at the end whole days matter.先把两种方案的费用写成天数的函数，再问何时 A < B；最后要考虑天数必须是整数。

quiz.q: Solve x2−9>0.解 x2−9>0。
quiz.a: x<−3 or x>3x<−3 或 x>3
quiz.sol: • Positive outside the zeros: (−∞,−3)∪(3,∞).两零点外侧为正：(−∞,−3)∪(3,∞)。
quiz.goal: Read the solution of a difference-of-squares inequality from its zeros.从零点读出平方差型不等式的解。
quiz.idea: x² - 9 = (x-3)(x+3): an upward parabola is positive outside its zeros.x² - 9 = (x-3)(x+3)：开口向上的抛物线在零点外侧为正。

quiz.q: Where is f(x)=(x−1)(x−5) negative?f(x)=(x−1)(x−5) 在哪里为负？
c: x<1 or x>5
1<x<5
1≤x≤5
x>5
quiz.a: 1<x<5
quiz.sol: • Test x=3: (2)(−2)=−4<0 ✓.代 x=3：(2)(−2)=−4<0 ✓。
quiz.goal: Recognise where a product of two linear factors is negative.判断两个一次因式的乘积在哪里为负。
quiz.idea: Zeros at 1 and 5, opens up, so the dip between them is negative.零点在 1 和 5，开口向上，两者之间的凹处为负。

quiz.q: Solve x2+2x≥15.解 x2+2x≥15。
quiz.a: x≤−5 or x≥3x≤−5 或 x≥3
quiz.sol: • Zeros −5, 3; opens up; outside, zeros included: (−∞,−5]∪[3,∞).零点 −5、3；开口向上；取外侧并含零点：(−∞,−5]∪[3,∞)。
quiz.goal: Move everything to one side, factor and solve, including the zeros.先移项到一边，再分解求解，并包含零点。
quiz.idea: Compare with 0 first: x² + 2x - 15 ≥ 0.先和 0 比较：x² + 2x - 15 ≥ 0。

quiz.q: For f(x)=−x2+2x+8, state the intervals where f(x) is positive, negative and zero.对 f(x)=−x2+2x+8，写出 f(x) 为正、为负、为零的区间。
quiz.a: positive on (−2,4); negative on (−∞,−2)∪(4,∞); zero at x=−2, 4在 (−2,4) 上为正；在 (−∞,−2)∪(4,∞) 上为负；在 x=−2, 4 处为零
quiz.sol: • Zeros −2 and 4. Opens down, so it is above the axis between them and below outside.零点 −2 和 4。开口向下，中间在 x 轴上方，两侧在下方。
quiz.goal: State where a downward-opening quadratic is positive, negative and zero.说出开口向下的二次函数在哪里为正、为负、为零。
quiz.idea: Factor out -1, find the zeros -2 and 4, then use the downward shape.提出 -1 分解，得零点 -2 和 4，再用开口向下的形状。

quiz.q: Solve x2−4x−1≤0 (exact).解 x2−4x−1≤0（精确值）。
quiz.a: 2−5​≤x≤2+5​
quiz.sol: • Zeros 2±5​; opens up; between, inclusive: [2−5​,2+5​].零点 2±5​；开口向上；取中间含端点：[2−5​,2+5​]。
quiz.goal: Choose a method when the quadratic does not factor, then solve the inequality exactly.二次式不能分解时选择方法，并精确解出不等式。
quiz.idea: It will not factor, so get the zeros exactly by completing the square or the formula, then use the shape.不能分解，就用配方或求根公式精确求零点，再看形状。

quiz.q: Solve (a) x2+2x+5>0 and (b) x2+2x+5<0.解 (a) x2+2x+5>0；(b) x2+2x+5<0。
c: (a) all reals; (b) no solution(a) 全体实数；(b) 无解
(a) no solution; (b) all reals(a) 无解；(b) 全体实数
(a) x>−1; (b) x<−1
both all reals两个都是全体实数
quiz.a: (a) all real numbers; (b) no solution(a) 全体实数；(b) 无解
quiz.sol: • No zeros and opens up, so it is always positive: (x+1)2+4>0.没有零点且开口向上，恒为正：(x+1)2+4>0。
quiz.goal: Use the discriminant and the opening direction to tell whether a quadratic is always positive or never negative.用判别式和开口方向判断二次式是否恒正或恒不为负。
quiz.idea: D < 0 means no x-intercepts, so the graph stays on one side of the axis.D < 0 表示与 x 轴无交点，图象始终在轴的同一侧。

quiz.q: Solve −x2+6x−9≥0.解 −x2+6x−9≥0。
quiz.a: x=3 only只有 x=3
quiz.sol: • −(x−3)2 is never positive; it equals 0 only at x=3.−(x−3)2 永远不为正，只在 x=3 时等于 0。
quiz.goal: Recognise a perfect-square quadratic with a double zero and its unusual solution set.认出带重根的完全平方二次式，及其特殊的解集。
quiz.idea: Rewrite as -(x-3)²: it is never positive and equals 0 only at x = 3.改写为 -(x-3)²：它永远不为正，只在 x = 3 处等于 0。

quiz.q: A minor-hockey club runs a tournament. At a ticket price of x dollars it expects 400−20x spectators (for 0≤x≤20). The hall costs 600 dollars plus 2 dollars per spectator. (a) Show that the profit is P(x)=−20x2+440x−1400. (b) For which ticket prices is the profit at least 1000 dollars? (c) The club hopes for 1100 dollars. Is that possible? Justify.一家少年冰球俱乐部办赛事。票价为 x 加元时预计有 400−20x 名观众（0≤x≤20）。场地费 600 加元，另外每位观众 2 加元。(a) 证明利润 P(x)=−20x2+440x−1400；(b) 票价在什么范围时利润至少 1000 加元？(c) 俱乐部希望赚 1100 加元，可能吗？说明理由。
quiz.a: (b) 10≤x≤12 dollars. (c) No: the maximum profit is 1020 dollars (at x=11), which is less than 1100.(b) 票价 10≤x≤12 加元。(c) 不可能：最大利润是 1020 加元（x=11 时），低于 1100。
quiz.sol:
• Revenue x(400−20x); cost 600+2(400−20x)=1400−40x. So P=400x−20x2−1400+40x=−20x2+440x−1400.收入 x(400−20x)；成本 600+2(400−20x)=1400−40x。所以 P=400x−20x2−1400+40x=−20x2+440x−1400。
  • P≥1000⇒−20x2+440x−2400≥0⇒x2−22x+120≤0⇒(x−10)(x−12)≤0.P≥1000⇒−20x2+440x−2400≥0⇒x2−22x+120≤0⇒(x−10)(x−12)≤0。
  • Upward parabola, between the zeros: 10≤x≤12, inside the domain 0≤x≤20.开口向上，取两零点之间：10≤x≤12，在定义域 0≤x≤20 内。
  • Vertex at x=11: P(11)=−2420+4840−1400=1020. Since 1020<1100, 1100 dollars is impossible.顶点在 x=11：P(11)=−2420+4840−1400=1020。因为 1020<1100，赚 1100 加元不可能。
quiz.goal: Build a profit model from a description, use an inequality to find a target range, and use the maximum to rule out an impossible goal.根据描述建立利润模型，用不等式求达标范围，并用最大值否定不可能的目标。
quiz.idea: Write profit from revenue and cost, then compare with the target: an inequality for the range, the vertex for the limit.先由收入和成本写出利润，再与目标比较：范围用不等式，极限看顶点。

quiz.q: A ball has height h(t)=−5t2+10t+15. When does it land? State the domain.球的高度 h(t)=−5t2+10t+15。什么时候落地？写出定义域。
quiz.a: lands at t=3 s; domain 0≤t≤3t=3 秒落地；定义域 0≤t≤3
quiz.sol: • (t−3)(t+1)=0; reject −1; 0≤t≤3.(t−3)(t+1)=0；舍去 −1；0≤t≤3。
quiz.goal: Find when a projectile lands and state the time domain.求抛体何时落地，并写出时间的定义域。
quiz.idea: Landing means h = 0; reject the negative time.落地即 h = 0；舍去负的时间。

quiz.q: A rectangle has perimeter 24 cm and width x, so A=x(12−x). The domain is:长方形周长 24 cm，宽为 x，A=x(12−x)。定义域是：
c: x∈R
0<x<12
0<x<24
x>0
quiz.a: 0<x<12
quiz.sol: • x>0 and 12−x>0.x>0 且 12−x>0。
quiz.goal: Find the domain of an area model from the two side lengths.由两条边长求面积模型的定义域。
quiz.idea: Both x and 12 - x must be positive.x 和 12 - x 都必须为正。

quiz.q: For h(t)=−5t2+10t+15 with domain 0≤t≤3, find the range.h(t)=−5t2+10t+15，定义域 0≤t≤3，求值域。
quiz.a: 0≤h≤20
quiz.sol: • h(1)=−5+10+15=20 (max); h(3)=0 (min).h(1)=−5+10+15=20（最大）；h(3)=0（最小）。
quiz.goal: Find the range of a projectile over its time domain.求抛体在其时间定义域内的值域。
quiz.idea: The range runs from the lowest end value to the vertex height.值域从定义域端点的最低值到顶点高度。

quiz.q: A company profit is P(x)=−x2+14x−40 (thousands of dollars) for x thousand units. For what production levels is the profit positive?公司利润 P(x)=−x2+14x−40（千加元），x 为产量（千件）。产量在什么范围内利润为正？
quiz.a: 4<x<10 (between 4000 and 10 000 units)4<x<10（4000 到 10 000 件之间）
quiz.sol: • Zeros 4 and 10; opens down; positive between.零点 4 和 10；开口向下；中间为正。
quiz.goal: Find where a profit model is positive and interpret it as production levels.求利润模型何时为正，并解释为产量范围。
quiz.idea: Profit > 0 is a quadratic inequality; the zeros are the break-even outputs.利润 > 0 是二次不等式；零点就是盈亏平衡产量。

quiz.q: A model gives the number of students n at a dance. Which domain description fits best?某模型中 n 表示参加舞会的学生人数。哪种定义域描述最合适？
c: n∈R
n≥0, n∈R
0≤n≤ capacity, n a whole number0≤n≤ 容量，n 为整数
n>0
quiz.a: whole numbers from 0 up to the room capacity0 到场地容量之间的整数
quiz.sol: • People come in whole numbers and the room has a limit.人数只能是整数，而且场地有上限。
quiz.goal: Choose a realistic domain for a counting variable.为一个计数变量选择符合实际的定义域。
quiz.idea: Ask whether fractions, negatives and values above the capacity can really happen.问一问：分数、负数、超过容量的值会不会真的出现。

quiz.q: A ball has height h(t)=−4.9t2+19.6t+2. During what times is it higher than 16.7 m?球的高度 h(t)=−4.9t2+19.6t+2。在什么时间段内高于 16.7 m？
quiz.a: 1<t<3 (s)1<t<3（秒）
quiz.sol: • t2−4t+3<0⇒(t−1)(t−3)<0⇒1<t<3.t2−4t+3<0⇒(t−1)(t−3)<0⇒1<t<3。
quiz.goal: Rewrite an inequality with decimal coefficients and solve it for a time window.改写带小数系数的不等式，并解出时间段。
quiz.idea: Divide by -4.9 (and flip) to get a clean quadratic, or notice that 16.7 is exactly 4.9 below the peak.除以 -4.9（并变号）得到整洁的二次式；或注意到 16.7 恰好比最高点低 4.9。

quiz.q: A pen against a barn uses 30 m of fence on three sides: A=x(30−2x). For what widths x is the area at least 100 m²?靠谷仓的围栏三面共用 30 m 篱笆：A=x(30−2x)。宽 x 在什么范围时面积至少 100 m²？
quiz.a: 5≤x≤10 (m)5≤x≤10（米）
quiz.sol:
• −2x2+30x−100≥0⇒x2−15x+50≤0⇒(x−5)(x−10)≤0.−2x2+30x−100≥0⇒x2−15x+50≤0⇒(x−5)(x−10)≤0。
  • 5≤x≤10, inside the domain 0<x<15.5≤x≤10，在定义域 0<x<15 内。
quiz.goal: Find the widths that give a minimum area and check them against the domain.求满足最小面积的宽度，并和定义域对照。
quiz.idea: Area ≥ 100 is a quadratic inequality; solve it, then confirm the interval fits 0 < x < 15.面积 ≥ 100 是二次不等式；解出后确认区间落在 0 < x < 15 之内。

quiz.q: A rock is thrown up from the top of a 25 m cliff beside the ocean: h(t)=−5t2+10t+25 (h in metres above the water, t in seconds). (a) State the domain and range. (b) A camera only records the rock while it is higher than 28 m. A friend says that is about 2 s. Is she right? Give the time window.从海边 25 m 高的悬崖顶向上扔一块石头：h(t)=−5t2+10t+25（h 为离水面的高度，单位米；t 单位为秒）。(a) 写出定义域和值域；(b) 摄像机只在石头高于 28 m 时录像。朋友说大约录 2 秒，对吗？给出录像的时间段。
quiz.a: (a) 0≤t≤1+6​ (≈3.4 s), 0≤h≤30. (b) She is wrong: the rock is above 28 m for 1−510​​<t<1+510​​, about 1.3 s.(a) 0≤t≤1+6​ (≈3.4 秒)，0≤h≤30。(b) 朋友说错了：石头高于 28 m 的时间段是 1−510​​<t<1+510​​，约 1.3 秒。
quiz.sol:
• h=0: t2−2t−5=0, so t=1±6​. Reject the negative root: domain 0≤t≤1+6​≈3.4.h=0：t2−2t−5=0，t=1±6​。舍去负根：定义域 0≤t≤1+6​≈3.4。
  • Vertex t=1: h=30. At the end of the domain h=0, and h(0)=25, so the range is 0≤h≤30.顶点 t=1：h=30。定义域末端 h=0，且 h(0)=25，所以值域是 0≤h≤30。
  • h>28: −5(t−1)2+30>28⇒(t−1)2<52​, so ∣t−1∣<52​​=510​​≈0.63.h>28：−5(t−1)2+30>28⇒(t−1)2<52​，所以 ∣t−1∣<52​​=510​​≈0.63。
  • Window: about 0.37<t<1.63, which is inside the domain. Length 2×0.63≈1.3 s, not 2 s.时间段：约 0.37<t<1.63，在定义域内。长度 2×0.63≈1.3 秒，不是 2 秒。
quiz.goal: Find the domain, range and a time window for a cliff-launch model, and use the answer to test a claim.求悬崖抛体模型的定义域、值域和一个时间段，并用结果检验别人的说法。
quiz.idea: Start from the height at launch and the vertex; the domain ends at the positive zero, and the camera window is a quadratic inequality centred on the peak.先看出发高度和顶点；定义域止于正的零点，而摄像机录像的时间段是以最高点为中心的二次不等式。

diag.q: Solve 7−2x≤15.解 7−2x≤15。
c: x≤−4
x≥4
x≥−4
x≥−11
why: Divided by −2 without flipping the sign.除以 −2 时没有变号。
Sign slip moving the 7: wrote −2x≤−8, so x≥4.移 7 时符号错：写成 −2x≤−8，得 x≥4。
Correct: −2x≤8; divide by −2 and flip: x≥−4.正确：−2x≤8；除以 −2 并变号：x≥−4。
Added 7 instead of subtracting it: −2x≤22.7 加过去了而不是减：−2x≤22。
diag.goal: Solve a one-step negative-coefficient inequality.解系数为负的一元一次不等式。
diag.idea: Isolate x; dividing by −2 flips the sign.分离 x；除以 −2 要变号。

diag.q: Solve −5<3−2x≤9 and write the answer in interval notation.解 −5<3−2x≤9，用区间表示。
c: (−3,4]
(−4,3]
(−∞,−3]∪(4,∞)
[−3,4)
why: Flipped the signs but left each bracket type at its old end: x≥−3 is closed at −3, x<4 is open at 4.变了号，但括号类型还留在原位置：x≥−3 在 −3 处闭，x<4 在 4 处开。
Divided by +2 (no flip) and mixed up the signs.除以了 +2（没变号），符号也乱了。
A double inequality is one connected interval ("and"), not two pieces.连写不等式是一个连续区间（「且」），不是两段。
Correct: −8<−2x≤6; divide by −2 and flip: 4>x≥−3.正确：−8<−2x≤6；除以 −2 并变号：4>x≥−3。
diag.goal: Solve a double inequality with a negative coefficient and write it in interval notation.解系数为负的连写不等式，并用区间表示。
diag.idea: Do each step to all three parts; after the flip, rewrite from smallest to largest.每步对三部分同时做；变号后按从小到大重写。

diag.q: Solve x2−2x−15≤0.解 x2−2x−15≤0。
c: −3≤x≤5
x≤−3 or x≥5
−5≤x≤3
−3<x<5
why: Correct: (x−5)(x+3)≤0; opens up, so ≤0 is between the zeros, endpoints included.正确：(x−5)(x+3)≤0；开口向上，≤0 在零点之间，含端点。
Picked the outside: that is where an upward parabola is positive.取了两侧：那是开口向上的抛物线为正的地方。
Zeros read with the wrong signs: (x−5)(x+3) has zeros 5 and −3.零点符号读反：(x−5)(x+3) 的零点是 5 和 −3。
≤ includes the zeros, so the endpoints are closed.≤ 包含零点，端点要取到。
diag.goal: Solve a factorable quadratic inequality.解能分解的二次不等式。
diag.idea: Zeros, then a quick sketch of an upward parabola.求零点，再画开口向上的草图。

diag.q: Solve x2+6x+9>0.解 x2+6x+9>0。
c: All real numbers全体实数
x>−3
All real numbers except x=−3除 x=−3 外的全体实数
No solution无解
why: At x=−3 the value is 0, and 0>0 is false.x=−3 时值为 0，而 0>0 不成立。
Treated it like a linear inequality; a square is positive on both sides of −3.当成一次不等式了；平方式在 −3 两侧都为正。
Correct: (x+3)2>0 for every x except −3.正确：除 x=−3 外，(x+3)2>0 恒成立。
D=0 does not mean no solution; it means the graph only touches the axis.D=0 不代表无解，只是图象与 x 轴相切。
diag.goal: Handle a quadratic inequality with a repeated root.处理有重根的二次不等式。
diag.idea: Recognize a perfect square: never negative, zero at one point.认出完全平方：永不为负，只在一点为零。

diag.q: A rectangle has perimeter 36 cm and width x cm, so its area is A=x(18−x). What is the domain?矩形周长 36 cm，宽 x cm，面积 A=x(18−x)。定义域是什么？
c: All real numbers全体实数
0≤x≤36
0<x<18
x>0
why: Ignored the context: a width cannot be negative or zero.忽略了情境：宽不能为负或零。
Used the perimeter as the limit; width + length is only 18.把周长当上限；宽加长只有 18。
Correct: width >0 and length 18−x>0.正确：宽 >0，长 18−x>0。
Forgot the upper limit: the length 18−x must be positive too.漏了上限：长 18−x 也必须为正。
diag.goal: State a physically sensible domain.写出符合实际的定义域。
diag.idea: Every length in the model must be positive.模型中每条长度都必须为正。

diag.q: A ball is thrown from a 60 m roof: h(t)=−5t2+20t+60 (m). What is the range in this context?从 60 m 高的屋顶抛出一个球：h(t)=−5t2+20t+60（米）。在情境中值域是什么？
c: 0≤h≤80
0≤h≤60
h≤80
60≤h≤80
why: Correct: domain 0≤t≤6; top at t=2 is 80; bottom is 0 when it lands.正确：定义域 0≤t≤6；t=2 时最高 80；落地时最低 0。
Used the endpoints only and missed the vertex height 80.只看了端点，漏了顶点高度 80。
No lower limit: the ball stops at the ground, h=0.没有下限：球落地就停，h=0。
Took the start height as the minimum; the ball falls to the ground.把起始高度当最小值；球会一直落到地面。
diag.goal: Find a range from a context domain, using both the vertex and the endpoints.由情境定义域求值域，同时用顶点和端点。
diag.idea: Find the domain first (landing time), then the highest and lowest heights in it.先求定义域（落地时间），再找其中的最高和最低高度。
